ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

BreakdownValue.description: The breakdown value this color applies to, as it appears in the chart legend.

ColorToken.description: Palette slot to color the value with, as `preset-1` upwards. Not a CSS color.

BreakdownType.description: Breakdown type the value came from, such as `event`, `person`, `session` or `cohort`.

BreakdownProperty.description: Breakdown property the color is scoped to. Omit to apply it under every property.
